assessment.nobel_worthiness: A foundational advance that made predictive first-principles materials calculations broadly practical and quantitatively reliable.
assessment.attribution: The listed names represent the decisive pseudopotential and PAW developments and their influential practical realization.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Room-temperature giant tunnel magnetoresistance is a clear quantum-transport discovery with transformative technological consequences.
assessment.attribution: The three proposed names cover central experimental discovery and development of tunnel-magnetoresistive structures.
assessment.maturity: The effect is robust, repeatedly confirmed, and embedded in established magnetic-device technology.
uncertainties: The relative allocation of credit between early demonstrations and later device development requires careful historical review.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dynamical mean-field theory supplied a powerful, physically intelligible framework for correlated electrons and real materials.
assessment.attribution: The proposed trio captures the central conceptual and methodological development of the approach.
assessment.maturity: Its predictions and extensions have been extensively confronted with spectroscopy and material trends over many years.
uncertainties: The extent to which a general theoretical framework can be attributed to only three individuals needs close examination.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Aberration-corrected transmission electron microscopy changed the attainable resolution and the ability to determine structure atom by atom.
assessment.attribution: The listed contributors plausibly span the theoretical correction concept and its decisive instrumental realization.
assessment.maturity: The advance is long established and has become a broadly used quantitative materials-science tool.
uncertainties: The division between conceptual optics, engineering implementation, and later instrument development warrants review.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Iron-based high-temperature superconductivity opened a major new family of unconventional superconductors and reshaped the field.
assessment.attribution: Hosono is strongly identified with the breakthrough discovery.
assessment.maturity: The materials class and its unusual superconducting phenomenology have been independently established over a substantial period.
uncertainties: A complete microscopic account of high-temperature superconductivity in these materials remains unsettled.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Magic-angle graphene revealed an unexpected platform in which geometry and electronic correlations can be tuned with remarkable precision.
assessment.attribution: The proposed names appropriately connect the predictive theory with the experimental discovery.
assessment.maturity: The central correlated phases have stimulated extensive independent work, theory, and device development.
uncertainties: The detailed mechanisms and reproducibility boundaries of some correlated phases remain under active investigation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Quantum spin Hall physics established a new topological state of matter with protected boundary transport.
assessment.attribution: Kane and Mele supplied the key theoretical proposal, while Molenkamp is closely associated with experimental realization.
assessment.maturity: The topological framework and quantum-spin-Hall phenomena are firmly established in condensed-matter physics.
uncertainties: Its conceptual proximity to previously recognized topological-matter work requires particularly careful delimitation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Metal-halide perovskites introduced a striking semiconductor platform with exceptional optoelectronic performance and energy relevance.
assessment.attribution: The proposed names are associated with pioneering demonstrations that established perovskite solar cells.
assessment.maturity: Independent laboratories have confirmed the central materials physics and achieved rapid performance progress.
uncertainties: Long-term operational stability and the fundamental limits of these materials remain important unresolved issues.
